title: QUIC RFC 9000 STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED Send-Only Receive Policy Work Item
summary: Close the remaining RFC 9000 Section 19.13 receiver-side send-only STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED policy tail.
planned_changes:
- Add focused requirement-home proof that receive-capable streams accept STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED without a transport error.
- Keep direct stream-state proof that opened send-only streams return STREAM_STATE_ERROR.
- Add protected runtime proof that opened and uncreated send-only stream IDs close the connection with STREAM_STATE_ERROR and triggering frame type 0x15.
- Propagate the existing stream-state error through the protected Application Data frame loop instead of dropping it as an unclassified receive failure.
- Link the proof to dedicated architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts.
verification_plan: Run the focused S19P13-0002 requirement-home filter, run a Release build, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, and check the diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: Changing STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED parser or formatter behavior.
Changing STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED sender-side advisory emission scheduling.
Changing flow-control autotuning or credit publication.
completion_notes: Completed as a receive-policy topoff over the existing stream-state receive-capability seam and protected Application Data close path.
